body: Issue #20 started: evaluation only, no training/reward/default changes or parameter scan. The five exact issue19 sym_wrap final checkpoints and all 102400 fixed states passed phase+10 versus pure-spatial reflected-policy tests (actual float32 clock action errors below1.5e-6). Rules frozen before implementation: SHA256 482b0eace32724500e35a7e5ff126fae6304bbceeb96ae099fe02743d34f2fac. The full rule file will be archived. Signed half-cycle swaps include axial yaw sign reversal (k10 left=-k0 right); paired five-seed bootstrap95 residual intervals must include zero. Strict-USD gate uses abs(mean S)<=5deg for every command and reports all individual seeds. If this prerequisite fails, report simulator non-equivariance and stop subsequent original-USD factorial evaluations as requested. Zero-phase full-size action/state bitwise replay, left-authoritative strict USD mass/inertia/COM/joints/collisions/PD audit, runtime PhysX readback and no-policy standing checks are in progress. Data disk has only265MB free, so new artifacts stay on the remote server root disk /root/tw_stage1/issue20_20261114, with no local copies or deletion of retained models. Progress is recorded in Notion https://www.notion.so/403325d8231d8172995bf19510b8d760; Linear is not used.
